command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/tmp/omega-pr102-current
rm -rf "$ROOT"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT" -- --quiet
cd "$ROOT"
git fetch -q origin chatgpt-work/omega-research-organs-main-convergence-20260913

HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo HEAD=$HEAD
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
